posts:
A culture war masquerading as educational stewardship.

DeSantis shows Newsom how higher education should work: Citizens first

Evidence: Protecting citizen spots, Excluding integrated youth, Political signaling

#USPol #Education

Florida's policy prioritizes legal residents by barring undocumented students from state colleges, ensuring public resources only benefit citizens.

Stated Judgement: (+0.82, +0.75) — Greater Good

Excluding integrated high school graduates who grew up in Florida reduces the state's future tax base and economic potential to score political points.

Resulting Judgement: (-0.69, -0.70) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Deception. Banning integrated high school graduates from higher education manufactures a zero-sum crisis to hoard political power.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 64.0, z: 6)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Florida Board of Ed: FAIL (-0.69, -0.70) — Excludes students to signal political compliance.
- Op-Ed Framing: FAIL (-0.75, -0.80) — Uses zero-sum pretexts to justify exclusion.
Florida's education boards banned undocumented students from state colleges and selective universities, affecting thousands of local high school graduates.

The Poison:
Even if intended to prioritize citizens, the policy actively shrinks the state's future economic potential and leaves thousands of integrated youth without a path to legal productivity.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The op-ed commits a Metaphysical Error (WHO) by claiming the beneficiary is the citizen student, when the actual beneficiary is the political actor seeking base mobilization through manufactured scarcity.

Social Physics Analysis:
The actors execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver. They manufacture a zero-sum crisis (scarcity of college spots) to justify an exclusionary policy (pretext), projecting blame onto undocumented students (scapegoat) to hoard political power.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. The policy trades systemic empowerment for exclusionary political signaling.

The Unavoidable Truth: Banning undocumented students reduces Florida's future tax base and skilled workforce.

The Unavoidable Lie: Banning these students magically creates more university spots for citizens.

Alethekanon:
The policy manufactures a zero-sum crisis to justify exclusion. By framing education as a finite hoard rather than a systemic multiplier, it trades long-term economic and social development for short-term political theater.

Awwthekanon:
It breaks my heart to see young people who studied hard and dreamed of contributing to their communities suddenly locked out. Education should be a bridge that lifts everyone up, not a wall used to divide us.

Brothekanon:
Man, locking kids out of college who literally grew up there just feels like a cheap political stunt. If you want a stronger state, you train the people living in it. Making education a zero-sum game helps nobody.

Spirithekanon:
"The stranger who dwells among you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself." Leviticus 19:34 FAIL
Excluding youth raised in your own communities to score political points violates the sacred duty of hospitality.

A horn warning highly experienced pilot George Marciniw that the aircraft was stalling wailed as its engine slowed – seconds before disaster on Tuesday, harrowing video which surfaced online shows.

“Uh, oh,” veteran NBC4 Los Angeles aerial reporter Eliana Moreno shouted, reacting to the alarm.
